# Atul Rajput

> Software Developer specializing in React Native mobile applications, web development, Python, and Machine Learning. This is my personal portfolio website.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://eatulrajput.netlify.app/): The main page showcasing my biography, skills grid, professional/educational experience timelines, certifications, and a contact form.
- [Gallery](https://eatulrajput.netlify.app/gallery): An interactive creative showcase categorized by photography, designs, and paintings, featuring a sliding marquee and fullscreen lightbox.
- [Projects](https://eatulrajput.netlify.app/project): A searchable and tag-filterable index of engineering and development projects.
- [Blog](https://eatulrajput.netlify.app/blog): A personal blog powered by MDX and local markdown files, featuring articles on software development, philosophy, and learning.
- [Resources](https://eatulrajput.netlify.app/resources): A repository of curated technical assets, guides, and developer tools.
- [Engineering Course](https://eatulrajput.netlify.app/eng): Academic coursework repository covering computer science and engineering modules.
- [System Status](https://eatulrajput.netlify.app/status): Real-time operational status dashboard showing uptime, response times, and incident history for all monitored services.

## Featured Projects

- [Community Mapping](https://eatulrajput.netlify.app/project/community-mapping): An immersive visualization detailing custom mapping utilities and interactive geographical overlays.
- [Astra AI](https://eatulrajput.netlify.app/project/astra-ai): A showcase highlighting AI agent integrations and automated software development tools.
